sentences.en: And the fact is, I think, because I've been predominantly single for most of the past four years, since I started
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想，因为自我开始写这个主题以来的过去四年里，我大部分时间都是单身，

sentences.en: writing about this subject, people are naturally making that conflation.
sentences.zh: 人们自然而然地把这两者混为一谈了。

sentences.en: I guess the way that I like to think about it is alonement, the ideas of alonement about how to spend time alone healthily
sentences.zh: 我想我喜欢思考它的方式是“独处艺术”，关于如何健康地度过独处时间，

sentences.en: and how to balance that with our natural desire for social time as well.
sentences.zh: 以及如何将这一点与我们对社交时间的自然渴望相平衡。

sentences.en: I think that being single can be a really fertile ground to explore that.
sentences.zh: 我认为单身可以成为探索这一点的绝佳沃土。

sentences.en: So yeah, it's really, it is very open to interpretation.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这确实非常开放，有各种各样的解读。

sentences.en: And for a lot of people, that's when they discover my book and my podcast and my platform when they are in a period of being single.

sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons I wanted to invite you on, we've worked quite a lot together in terms of guest expert for your journalism pieces, which I've loved being part of.
sentences.zh: 我邀请你来的原因之一是，我们曾在你的新闻报道中作为特邀专家进行过很多合作，我非常喜欢参与其中。

sentences.en: So thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's been so lovely working with you.
sentences.zh: 和你合作非常愉快。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: One of the reasons I wanted to bring you on is because psychology can be what feels like quite a solo pursuit, because it's you and your career and you're having to make
sentences.zh: 我想把你请来的原因之一是因为心理学有时感觉像是一项相当孤独的追求，因为那是你和你的职业生涯，你必须做出

sentences.en: decisions that might be in isolation of those around you.

sentences.en: And in fact, one of the decisions I made was sort of to decide to split up a relationship because I wanted, I knew where I was going.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我做出的决定之一就是结束一段恋爱关系，因为我想，我知道我要去哪里。

sentences.zh: 我知道这需要我寻找新的途径、新的联系，并努力走出自己的路。

sentences.en: But it means that quite often people are restarting or starting a new chapter of their life.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着很多时候人们在重新开始或者开启人生的新篇章。

sentences.en: And they're doing it in a way that feels like they might be quite isolated or sometimes even
sentences.zh: 他们这样做的方式让他们觉得可能会相当孤立，有时甚至

sentences.zh: 他们不得不搬到国家的那一头，无论是为了工作机会还是课程录取。

sentences.en: And it might mean either not living with their family or commuting back to their family or just, just even if you are moving with your family, trying to start over again.
sentences.zh: 这意味着可能无法与家人同住，或者要通勤回家人身边，或者即使你和家人一起搬迁，也要尝试重新开始。

sentences.en: It's really, really complicated.
sentences.zh: 这真的、真的很复杂。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I think there are so many things worth doing in life.
sentences.zh: 我认为生活中有很多事情是值得去做的。

sentences.en: There are so many things that are the most, probably in the most self-actualizing things that you might do, whether
sentences.zh: 有许多事情是最具自我实现意义的，无论

sentences.en: that's being able to travel or live abroad for a period or pursuing something like psychology as a profession.
sentences.zh: 那是能够去旅游、在国外住上一段时间，还是追求像心理学这样的专业。

sentences.en: A lot of those things, they require overcoming some sort of fear of being alone.
sentences.zh: 许多事情都需要克服某种对独处的恐惧。

sentences.en: And I don't think we really speak enough about how often that fear, even whether, you know, whether it's
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们并没有充分讨论这种恐惧，无论是

sentences.en: named or not, is the thing that actually stops people from pursuing their dreaMs. And then people,
sentences.zh: 否被命名，它实际上就是阻止人们追求梦想的东西。然后人们，

sentences.en: you know, and then further down the line, you know, 10, 20 years, it's like, oh, I never did this because of so-and-so.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在多年以后，比如10年、20年后，会说，哦，我从来没有因为某某原因做过这个。

sentences.en: And I think that that resentment's probably loaded in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种怨恨可能放错了位置。

sentences.en: I think that the first thing to tackle is, right, why is being alone so scary to begin with?
sentences.zh: 我认为首先要解决的问题是，对啊，为什么独处一开始会这么可怕？

sentences.en: In the last few years, we've all become not at all tolerant to the idea of being bored.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，我们对无聊的概念变得毫无容忍度。

sentences.en: And, you know, we've all become pretty ADHD about our phones, you know, and it's like, it's thought that it's as addictive as crack, isn't it, having a smartphone.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们对手机都有点注意力缺陷了，你知道，人们认为智能手机和可卡因一样容易上瘾，不是吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, someone was talking the other day about being on a train for three hours.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，前几天有人谈到在火车上坐了三个小时。

sentences.en: And they observed this older chap who just
sentences.zh: 他们观察到一位老先生只是

sentences.en: peacefully sat and watched, you know, the scenery unfold for those three hours, because he didn't, either didn't have a mobile or didn't choose to use it.
sentences.zh: 平静地坐在那里，看着窗外的风景流逝了三个小时，因为他要么没有手机，要么选择不使用它。

sentences.en: And in contrast to the people that were speaking, they were on their phones, they had their tablets, they had, you know, music to listen to.
sentences.zh: 与那些说话的人形成鲜明对比的是，他们拿着手机，拿着平板电脑，听着音乐。

sentences.en: It was like they couldn't bear to have that unstructured time of being just alone.
sentences.zh: 就好像他们无法忍受那种完全独自一人的非结构化时间。

sentences.en: They had to be part of something.
sentences.zh: 他们必须参与到某种事物中去。

sentences.en: How's your take on that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有什么看法？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, firstly, I don't know how much I believe in the idea of boredom.
sentences.zh: 是的，首先，我不知道我有多相信“无聊”这个概念。

sentences.en: I know it sounds like a sort of, you know, parent sort of saying this to a child, you know, sort of complaining about being bored.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来像是某种父母对抱怨无聊的孩子所说的话。

sentences.en: But I just think there are so many things that we have this wealth of information, entertainment, online and everywhere else, you
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得有太多东西，我们拥有丰富的资讯、娱乐，在线上和各处，

sentences.en: know, we have, I'm sounding really old here, you know, we have we have public libraries, we have
sentences.zh: 你知道，我在这里听起来真的很老派，我们有公共图书馆，我们有

sentences.en: we have the whole world is very, very stimulating and exciting, when we have the chance to experience it.
sentences.zh: 整个世界都是非常、非常具有刺激性和令人兴奋的，当我们有机会去体验它的时候。

sentences.en: And I think the problem is, we've normalized a level of, as you say, a level of noise, which is so
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于，我们已经把某种程度的，如你所说的那种噪音水平正常化了，这种噪音

sentences.en: distracting without allowing us to go into any depth.
sentences.zh: 非常分散注意力，却不允许我们做任何深入的思考。

sentences.en: And I think, I think it's crazy that our, you know, our attention spans are sort of evolving into a tick tock length period of time.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们的注意力持续时间正在演变成TikTok短视频的长度，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's, it's really crazy.
sentences.zh: 这真的很疯狂。

sentences.en: And, you know, I definitely can speak from my own experience, when I find myself feeling the most lonely, I'll be going on Instagram the most, but then inexplicably,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我绝对可以从我自己的经验说起，当我发现自己感到最孤独的时候，我会最频繁地刷Instagram，但随后莫名其妙地，

sentences.en: like ignoring all the WhatsApps from my close friends, or not feeling like I have time to reply to a voice note, but scrolling for hours and hours.
sentences.zh: 就像忽略所有来自好朋友的WhatsApp消息一样，或者觉得没有时间回复语音消息，却在不停地刷屏。

sentences.en: And I think it's that sense of, I don't know, it's like a sense of sort of calm and like groundedness, you need to get to, to be
sentences.zh: 我想那是一种，我不知道，那是一种平静和脚踏实地的感觉，你需要达到这种状态，

sentences.en: able to actually find this stuff, engaging in a way that feels nourishing, not just sort of distracting to the point that, like, you know, it's actually more like a crutch.
sentences.zh: 才能真正发现这些东西以一种滋养而非仅仅是分散注意力的方式吸引人，甚至更像是一种拐杖。

sentences.en: But I think that that's, it's why that I say that with, with alonement, with, you know, which, which alonement
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，这就是为什么我说“独处艺术”，（独处艺术）

sentences.en: just in and of itself just means kind of time alone, that's positive and fulfilling and nourishing in the opposite to loneliness.
sentences.zh: 本身就意味着一种积极、充实、滋养的独处时间，与孤独截然相反。

sentences.en: But I think to get to the state of alonement, the sounds very, very enlightened, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 但我觉得要达到这种独处状态，听起来非常、非常开明，对吧？

sentences.en: But you just to get to any positive alone time space, you need to have a grounding practice, like something like breath work, meditation, doesn't have
sentences.zh: 但你为了进入任何积极的独处时间空间，你需要有接地气的练习，比如呼吸练习、冥想，这不一定

sentences.en: to be as, you know, it doesn't have to sound as lofty as that, you know, walking by yourself,
sentences.zh: 要听起来那么崇高，比如一个人散步、

sentences.en: reading, whatever, something that will take you away from that frenetic, distracted state,
sentences.zh: 读书，或者任何能让你摆脱那种狂热、分心的状态，

sentences.en: to a bit more of a sort of slow exhaling state, that then you can enjoy things a bit more, and actually be a bit more comfortable in your own company to then be able to sort of
sentences.zh: 进入一种更缓慢、深呼吸的状态的事情，然后你就能更好地享受事物，在自己的陪伴下感到更舒适，进而

sentences.en: think about the bigger, the bigger periods of time you might spend by yourself.
sentences.zh: 去思考你可能独自度过的大块时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，完全同意。

sentences.zh: 我想这也是在思考你希望如何独处，对吧？

sentences.zh: 所以独处并不等于孤独。

sentences.en: And if you feel lonely, it's perhaps a sign that you can do things differently.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到孤独，这或许是一个信号，表明你可以采取不同的做法。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.zh: 这些年来我们一直有交流。

sentences.en: We've spoken via voice note and email and, and social media, but it's really lovely to have finally met her in in person.
sentences.zh: 我们通过语音留言、电子邮件以及社交媒体交流过，但能 finalmente 亲自见到她真是太好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I hope that you have taken something from our conversation today.
sentences.zh: 对，我希望你从今天的对话中有所收获。

sentences.en: I'd love to know what you have taken from it.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你从中有何收获。

sentences.en: If you'd like to come and connect with me on socials, I'm Dr.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在社交媒体上与我联系，我是

sentences.en: Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And there's also the Aspiring Psychologist community on Facebook that you're welcome to come and join and share your thoughts about how this has been insightful for

sentences.en: you and perhaps for your clients as well and how it will shape your thinking.
sentences.zh: 或许对你的来访者以及它将如何塑造你的思维也有所帮助。

sentences.en: Please do also connect with Francesca.
sentences.zh: 也请务必与弗兰西斯卡联系。

sentences.en: As she said, she is Shez Spector on Twitter and on Instagram.

sentences.en: There'll be a link for her book, Alonement, how to be alone and absolutely own it in the show notes too.

sentences.en: If you have got any ideas for future podcast episodes, please do get in touch.
sentences.zh: 如果你对未来的播客节目有任何想法，请随时与我们联系。

sentences.en: Um, even if you think it might not be a podcast episode, sometimes the questions you ask me evoke the idea of a podcast episode, just like today's.
sentences.zh: 嗯，即使你觉得它可能不适合做一期播客，有时你问我的问题也能激发出制作一期播客的想法，就像今天这样。

sentences.en: Um, I will be back along with your next podcast episode, which will be available from 6am on Monday.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我将带着你的下一期播客节目回归，该节目将于周一早上6点开始上线。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world and do be kind to yourself.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分，请对你自己好一点。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在身边，你将迈向由玛丽安·特伦特博士主持的“有志成为心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth and I'm a psychological wellbeing practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，我是来自纽卡斯尔的一名心理健康从业人员。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我只是想对《临床心理学家合集》一书的撰稿人们表示最诚挚的谢意。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢阅读这本书，也很高兴能深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所拥有的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 看到申请中潜在的障碍以及我如何尝试绕过这些障碍，也非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the clinical psychology doctorate, but this has
sentences.zh: 我真的开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否足够优秀去申请临床心理学博士，但这

sentences.zh: 真的给了我所需的自信，让我去尝试一下。

sentences.en: So the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: And no, spoiler alert, I wasn't teaching the Pilates.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，我并没有在教普拉提。

sentences.en: It was money coming into my business whilst I was doing something completely different.
sentences.zh: 那是在我做完全不同的事情时，流入我业务中的钱。

sentences.en: If you've ever wondered how you might create income that isn't directly tied to your time, there's a free challenge starting on the 2nd of November.

sentences.en: It's called The Race to Recurring
sentences.zh: 它被称为“追逐持续

sentences.en: Revenue.

sentences.en: It's hosted by Sophie Foot and I'd love you to join through my link so I can support you too.
sentences.zh: 它由索菲·福特主持，我希望你能通过我的链接加入，这样我也能支持你。

sentences.en: The details are in the show notes or you can drop me a DM via socials.
sentences.zh: 详细信息在节目文稿中，或者你可以通过社交媒体给我发私信。

sentences.en: Now on with the show.
